title: Havne plugin manifest
description: A Havne plugin's manifest (format 1, ADR-0052): a folder's manifest.json, or a packed plugin, one file holding the manifest and its data files under "files". A folder's data files take this schema's #/$defs/dataFile. Map this schema to your files in your editor's settings: the loader refuses a "$schema" key, as it refuses every key it doesn't know.
$comment: The loader (core/src/plugin.cpp) is the truth; tests/schema_keys.py keeps each object's keys equal to its only_keys sets, and the signals are signal-file.schema.json's. The loader alone checks: "havne_plugin" and a data file's "havne_signals" as the first key; the sizes (1 MiB a manifest or a data file, 16 MiB a package) and JSON's rules; lengths in UTF-8 bytes; whole numbers written with no fraction or exponent; which form a manifest is ("files" only in a packed plugin and required there, "fixtures" only in a folder's); every packed file in a variant, and every variant's file in "files" or in the folder; "requires.core" no later than the core reading it; a year range's first year no later than its last; variant ids given once each; the profile name made from "name" at most 63 characters; a data file's signals naming the manifest's ECUs, "extends" in a variant's first file only, a key once in each data file, a variant's merged signals passing every rule of a signal file (at most 1024, one signal file of at most 1 MiB written out); everything signal-file.schema.json leaves to its loader.

havne_plugin.title: Format
havne_plugin.description: The manifest format's version, and the manifest's first key. This Havne reads format 1.

id.title: Plugin id
id.description: 1 to 31 of a-z, 0-9 and -, a letter or digit at each end. Each variant's profile is plugin.<id>.<variant>.

name.title: Name
name.description: The plugin's name, 1 to 63 bytes with at least one letter or digit. A recording of a variant names its signal file by it.

version.title: Version
version.description: The plugin's own version, X.Y.Z: each 0 to 65535 with no leading zero, 15 characters at most.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: What the plugin needs to load.

core.title: Core version
core.description: The oldest Havne core that reads the plugin, X.Y.Z.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: What the plugin holds: ["data"] (signal files) is the only tier this Havne runs, and a plugin naming another is refused.

match.title: Match
match.description: The cars the plugin proposes itself for by their VIN, at most 32 rules. A match only proposes: the user picks the variant.

ecus.description: The modules the data files' signals read, named by id; a data file declares none of its own. The base set's count toward 4 in all, of one ID width.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: 1 to 32 named lists of data files, each list merged by signal key at load (a later file's signal replaces an earlier one's in its place, and adds the rest).

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.description: A folder's value-fixture files, at most 16, which havne-cli plugins check runs (plugin-fixtures.schema.json). A packed plugin carries none.

files.title: Files
files.description: A packed plugin's data files, at most 64, each by the path its variants name. A folder's manifest takes none.

not.$comment: A packed plugin carries no fixtures, and only a packed one has files

path.title: Path
path.description: A path in the package: relative, forward slashes, no empty, "." or ".." part, 1 to 127 printable ASCII characters but backslash and colon.

years.title: Model years
years.description: The first and the last model year, 1980 to 2039, inclusive.

match.title: Match rule
match.description: Manufacturer codes, and optionally the model years, a car's VIN must show.

wmi.title: Manufacturer codes
wmi.description: 1 to 64 world manufacturer identifiers: a VIN's first 3 characters, or 6 (the first 3 and the 12th to 14th) where the third is 9. Upper case, no I, O or Q.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: One variant: its data files in order, merged by signal key, and optionally the model years it's for.

id.title: Variant id
id.description: 1 to 24 of a-z, 0-9 and -, a letter or digit at each end. Its profile is plugin.<plugin id>.<variant id>.

files.title: Files
files.description: The variant's data files, 1 to 64, each once. Only the first may extend a set.

dataFile.title: Plugin data file
dataFile.description: A plugin's data file: a signal file whose signals name the manifest's ECUs by id and which declares none of its own. Its name and source are optional, the manifest's being the plugin's.

havne_signals.title: Format
havne_signals.description: The signal-file format's version, and the file's first key. This Havne reads format 1.

name.title: Name
name.description: The data file's own name, 1 to 63 bytes, for its reader: a variant's signal file takes the plugin's.

extends.description: A built-in set the variant adds to, only in a variant's first file: "obd2" in format 1.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: The file's signals, each key once. A variant's files' signals merged hold 1 to 1024.
